overview: This event is about showing up for the solo brief with the major risk, weather, and execution items already organized. Use these notes to walk in ahead of the day-of ODO/FDO brief instead of trying to build the whole picture on the spot.

studyNotes.headline: Discussion items

items.text: Treat the solo brief as a go/no-go gate, not an admin step. You should arrive already knowing the weather, runway, emergency, and support-agency items that will drive the brief.

children.text: Solo weather, runway, crosswind, BASH, landing, and divert limits.
Rear-cockpit securing items, unauthorized solo maneuver limits, and what will terminate the sortie early.
Emergency, lost-aircraft, and support-agency expectations if the profile does not stay routine.

items.text: The day-of ODO/FDO solo brief still remains required, even if these notes already make the overall picture familiar.

studyNotes.summary: Show up with the solo items already sorted, then use the day-of brief to confirm the go/no-go details instead of learning them from scratch.

summary: Solo-brief risk, weather, support-agency, and execution priorities.
title: Familiarization Solo Flight
